sentences.en: SALLY: Good morning.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 早上好。

sentences.en: Thanks for coming in to see us here at the agency, Joe.
sentences.zh: 感谢您今天来我们事务所面谈，乔。

sentences.en: I'm one of the agency representatives, and my name's Sally Baker.
sentences.zh: 我是本事务所的一名代表，我叫莎莉·贝克。

sentences.en: JOE: Hi Sally.
sentences.zh: JOE: 你好，莎莉。

sentences.en: I think we spoke on the phone, didn't we?
sentences.zh: 我想我们之前通过电话，对吧？

sentences.en: SALLY: That's right, we did.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 没错，我们确实通过。

sentences.en: So thank you for sending in your CV.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您提交了您的简历。

sentences.en: We've had quite a careful look at it and I think we have two jobs that might be suitable for you.
sentences.zh: 我们已仔细审阅过，并认为有两份工作可能适合您。

sentences.en: JOE: OK.
sentences.zh: JOE: 好的。

sentences.en: SALLY: The first one is in a company based in North London.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 第一份工作位于北伦敦的一家公司。

sentences.en: They're looking for an administrative assistant.
sentences.zh: 他们正在招聘一名行政助理。

sentences.en: JOE: OK.
sentences.zh: JOE: 好的。

sentences.en: What sort of company is it?
sentences.zh: 这是怎样一家公司？

sentences.en: SALLY: They're called Home Solutions and they design and make furniture.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 公司名叫‘家居解决方案’，主营家具的设计与制造。

sentences.en: JOE: Oh, I don't know much about that, but it sounds interesting.
sentences.zh: JOE: 哦，我对这方面了解不多，但听起来挺有意思的。

sentences.en: SALLY: Yes, well as I said, they want someone in their office, and looking at your past experience it does look as if you fit quite a few of the requirements.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 是的，正如我刚才所说，他们需要一位在办公室工作的人员；而根据您过往的经历来看，您似乎符合其中不少要求。

sentences.en: So on your CV it appears you've done some data entry?
sentences.zh: 因此，从您的简历上看，您曾从事过一些数据录入工作，对吗？

sentences.en: JOE: Yes.
sentences.zh: JOE: 是的。

sentences.en: SALLY: So that's one skill they want.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 这正是他们所需的一项技能。

sentences.en: Then they expect the person they appoint to attend meetings and take notes there
sentences.zh: 此外，他们希望被录用者能出席各类会议并在会上做记录。

sentences.en: JOE: OK.
sentences.zh: JOE: 好的。

sentences.en: I've done that before, yes.
sentences.zh: 我之前做过这类工作，是的。

sentences.en: SALLY: And you'd need to be able to cope with general admin.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 您还需能够胜任日常行政事务。

sentences.en: JOE: Filing, and keeping records and so on?
sentences.zh: JOE: 比如归档、保存记录等等？

sentences.en: That should be OK.
sentences.zh: 这应该没问题。

sentences.en: And in my last job I also had to manage the diary.
sentences.zh: 而且在我上一份工作中，我还负责管理日程安排。

sentences.en: SALLY: Excellent.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 太棒了。

sentences.en: That's something they want here too.
sentences.zh: 这一点他们也同样需要。

sentences.en: I'd suggest you add it to your CV - I don't think you mentioned that, did you?
sentences.zh: 我建议您将这项内容补充进您的简历——我想您之前并未提及，对吗？

sentences.en: JOE: No.
sentences.zh: JOE: 没有。

sentences.en: SALLY: So as far as the requirements go, they want good computer skills, of course, and they particularly mention spreadsheets.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 至于职位要求方面，他们当然希望应聘者具备良好的计算机操作能力，尤其强调电子表格应用能力。

sentences.en: JOE: That should be fine.
sentences.zh: JOE: 这应该没问题。

sentences.en: SALLY: And interpersonal skills - which would be something they'd check with your references.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 还有就是人际交往能力——这一点他们会通过您的推荐信加以核实。

sentences.en: JOE: think that should be OK, yes.
sentences.zh: JOE: 我想这方面应该也没问题，是的。

sentences.en: SALLY; Then they mention that they want someone who is careful and takes care with details - just looking at your CV, I'd say you're probably alright there.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 接着他们还提到，希望应聘者做事细致、注重细节——仅从您的简历来看，我认为您在这方面应该完全符合。

sentences.en: JOE: I think so, yes.
sentences.zh: JOE: 我想是的，没错。

sentences.en: Do they want any special experience?
sentences.zh: 他们是否要求任何特殊经验？

sentences.en: SALLY: I think they wanted some experience of teleconferencing.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 我觉得他们特别提到了远程电话会议方面的经验。

sentences.en: JOE: I've got three years' experience of that.
sentences.zh: JOE: 我在这方面已有三年经验。

sentences.en: SALLY: Let's see, yes, good.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 让我看看，是的，很好。

sentences.en: In fact they're only asking for at least one year, so that's great.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们只要求至少一年的工作经验，所以这很棒。

sentences.en: So is that something that might interest you?
sentences.zh: 那么，这个职位会令你感兴趣吗？

sentences.en: JOE: It is, yes.
sentences.zh: JOE: 是的，会。

sentences.en: The only thing is, you said they were in North London so it would be quite a long commute for me.
sentences.zh: 唯一的问题是，你说过他们在北伦敦，所以对我来说通勤时间会相当长。

sentences.en: SALLY: OK.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 好的。

sentences.en: SALLY: So the second position might suit you better as far as the location goes; that's for a warehouse assistant and that's in South London.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 那么，就地理位置而言，第二个职位可能更符合你的需求；那是仓库助理职位，位于南伦敦。

sentences.en: JOE: Yes, that would be a lot closer.
sentences.zh: JOE: 是的，那会近得多。

sentences.en: SALLY: in And you've worked in a warehouse before, haven't you?
sentences.zh: SALLY: 而且你之前在仓库工作过，对吧？

sentences.en: JOE: Yes.
sentences.zh: JOE: 是的。

sentences.en: Audioscripts
sentences.zh: 听力原文

sentences.en: SALLY: So as far as the responsibilities for this position go, they want someone who can manage the stock, obviously, and also deliveries.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 至于该职位的职责，他们显然需要一位能管理库存，同时也能处理货物配送的人。

sentences.en: JOE: That should be OK.
sentences.zh: JOE: 这应该没问题。

sentences.en: You've got to keep track of stuff, but I've always been quite good with numbers.
sentences.zh: 你需要跟踪记录各类物品，而我一向擅长处理数字。

sentences.en: SALLY: Good. that's their first requirement.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 很好，这是他们的第一项要求。

sentences.en: And they want someone who's computer literate, which we know you are.
sentences.zh: 此外，他们希望应聘者具备基本的计算机操作能力，我们知道你完全符合这一点。

sentences.en: JOE: Sure.
sentences.zh: JOE: 当然。

sentences.en: SALLY: Then they mention organisational skills.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 然后他们提到了组织能力。

sentences.en: They want someone who's well organised.
sentences.zh: 他们希望应聘者做事有条理。

sentences.en: JOE: Yes, I think I am.
sentences.zh: JOE: 是的，我觉得我确实如此。

sentences.en: SALLY: And tidy?
sentences.zh: SALLY: 并且整洁？

sentences.en: JOE: Yes, they go together really, don't they?
sentences.zh: JOE: 是的，这两者其实是相辅相成的，不是吗？

sentences.en: SALLY: Sure.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 没错。

sentences.en: Then the usual stuff; they want someone who can communicate well both orally and in writing.
sentences.zh: 接着是一些常规要求：他们希望应聘者具备良好的口头和书面沟通能力。

sentences.en: JOE: OK.
sentences.zh: JOE: 好的。

sentences.en: And for the last warehouse job I had, one of the things I enjoyed most was being part of a team.
sentences.zh: 而在上一份仓库工作中，我最享受的事情之一就是成为团队的一员。

sentences.en: I found that was really essential for the job.
sentences.zh: 我发现这对工作而言确实至关重要。

sentences.en: SALLY: Excellent.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Yes, they do mention that they want someone who's used to that, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们确实提到希望应聘者习惯团队协作。

sentences.en: Now when you were working in a warehouse last time, what sorts of items were you dealing with?
sentences.zh: 那么，你上次在仓库工作时，主要处理哪些类型的物品呢？

sentences.en: JOE: It was mostly bathroom and kitchen equipment, sinks and stoves and fridges.
sentences.zh: JOE: 主要是卫浴和厨房设备，比如水槽、炉灶和冰箱。

sentences.en: SALLY: So you're OK moving heavy things?
sentences.zh: SALLY: 所以你搬动重物没有问题吧？

sentences.en: JOE.
sentences.zh: JOE。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然没问题。

sentences.en: I'm quite strong, and I've had the training.
sentences.zh: 我体力不错，而且也接受过相关培训。

sentences.en: SALLY: Good.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 很好。

sentences.en: Now as far as experience goes, they mention they want someone with a licence, and that you have experience of driving in London - so you can cope with the traffic and sO on.
sentences.zh: 至于工作经验方面，他们提到希望应聘者持有驾照，并且有在伦敦驾车的经验——也就是说你能应对当地交通状况等。

sentences.en: JOE: Yes, no problem.
sentences.zh: JOE: 是的，完全没有问题。

sentences.en: SALLY: And you've got experience of warehouse work and the final thing they mention is customer service.
sentences.zh: SALLY: 而且你具备仓库工作经验，最后一点他们提到的是客户服务能力。

sentences.en: I think looking at your CV you're OK there.
sentences.zh: 从你的简历来看，这方面你也完全符合要求。

sentences.en: JOE: Right.
sentences.zh: JOE: 明白了。

sentences.en: So what about pay? a Can you tell me a bit more about that, please ...
